The updating phase happens when state or props change, causing the component to re-render and reflect new data. getDerivedStateFromProps(): Synchs state with changing props. render(): Re-evaluates and updates the virtual DOM. getSnapshotBeforeUpdate(): Captures information from the DOM right before it changes. componentDidUpdate(): Executes right after updates finish flushing to the DOM. 3.Unmounting Phase
The unmounting phase is the final stage when a component is removed from the DOMcomponentWillUnmount(): Cleans up timers, subscriptions, or network requests to prevent memory leaks.
